entry_timeframe_note: Daily is the primary timeframe for bias, regime detection, and S/R levels. CannonTrading daily levels and commentary are also Daily-based — all three data sources (TWB, NW, S/R, CannonEdge) align on Daily. Drop to 4H for entry timing on liquid instruments (equity index, energy, metals, FX). For grains, livestock, and softs, Daily entry is acceptable — 4H liquidity is thin outside US session.
required_indicators: Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks [LuxAlgo]

market_context.note: Futures are multi-sector — no single benchmark. Evaluate each symbol independently on its own trend and mean-reversion signals.
macro_overlays: DXY trend affects metals, energy, FX futures — strong dollar = headwind for commodities and EM
ZB/ZN direction (bonds) affects equity index futures — rising yields = headwind for ES/NQ
VX1! level: above 20 = elevated volatility regime, reduce position size; above 30 = crisis mode, mean-revert only

regime_detection.trending: TWB Histogram clearly positive or negative for 3+ bars. Price making HH/HL (uptrend) or LL/LH (downtrend). NW Envelope angled, price riding outside or near outer band.
regime_detection.mean_reverting: TWB Histogram near zero or reversing. Price extended beyond NW Envelope outer band (triangle label present). No clear HH/HL or LL/LH structure.

trend_long: TWB Histogram positive (above zero) and rising
TWB signal line crossed above zero (higher conviction)
Price making HH/HL structure on daily
Price near or inside upper NW band — not yet overextended
Volume confirming the move (above average on breakout bars)
trend_short: TWB Histogram negative (below zero) and falling
TWB signal line crossed below zero (higher conviction)
Price making LL/LH structure on daily
Price near or inside lower NW band — not yet overextended
mean_rev_long: TWB Histogram reversing from deeply negative (histogram turning up from lows)
NW Envelope: recent down-triangle label (price dropped through lower band) — potential snap-back zone
Price at or below lower NW band — stretched, look for reversal candle
S/R: price at or below sr_support level — stronger snap-back probability
Volume drying up on the sell-off (exhaustion)
mean_rev_short: TWB Histogram reversing from deeply positive (histogram turning down from highs)
NW Envelope: recent up-triangle label (price broke above upper band) — potential snap-back zone
Price at or above upper NW band — stretched, look for rejection candle
S/R: price at or above sr_resistance level — stronger rejection probability
Volume drying up on the rally (exhaustion)
neutral: TWB Histogram near zero, no direction
Price inside NW bands with no ▲ or ▼ signal
No clear HH/HL or LL/LH structure — choppy/consolidating

trend_long_entry: Pullback to recent breakout level or sr_support on daily
TWB Histogram remains positive during pullback (dip, not reversal)
NW Envelope: price approaching but not through upper band
S/R: sr_break > 0 adds conviction (resistance just broke and became support)
Entry on first bullish close after pullback
trend_short_entry: Dead-cat bounce to recent breakdown level or sr_resistance on daily
TWB Histogram remains negative during bounce
NW Envelope: price approaching but not through lower band from below
S/R: sr_break < 0 adds conviction (support just broke and became resistance)
Entry on first bearish close after bounce
mean_rev_long_entry: Price at or below lower NW band
Reversal candle: hammer, engulfing, or inside bar at support
TWB Histogram beginning to turn up (first positive bar after negative run)
Do NOT enter mid-fall — wait for the turn signal
mean_rev_short_entry: Price at or above upper NW band
Rejection candle: shooting star, bearish engulfing, or inside bar at resistance
TWB Histogram beginning to turn down (first negative bar after positive run)
Do NOT enter mid-rally — wait for the turn signal

trend_long.stop: Below the most recent swing low or breakout candle low
trend_long.tp2: Trail with 4H swing lows — exit on close below most recent 4H higher low
trend_long.tp3: TWB Histogram crosses below zero — full exit

trend_short.stop: Above the most recent swing high or breakdown candle high
trend_short.tp2: Trail with 4H swing highs — exit on close above most recent 4H lower high
trend_short.tp3: TWB Histogram crosses above zero — full exit

mean_rev_long.stop: Below the recent low that triggered the entry (1-2 ATR buffer)
mean_rev_long.tp1: Middle of NW band (mean) — scale out 1/2
mean_rev_long.tp2: Upper NW band or prior resistance — full exit
mean_rev_long.note: Mean reversion trades are shorter duration — take profits quickly, do not trail aggressively

mean_rev_short.stop: Above the recent high that triggered the entry (1-2 ATR buffer)
mean_rev_short.tp1: Middle of NW band (mean) — scale out 1/2
mean_rev_short.tp2: Lower NW band or prior support — full exit
mean_rev_short.note: Mean reversion trades are shorter duration — take profits quickly

risk_rules: Max 1.5% risk per trade (futures leverage is significant)
Max 3 positions open at once across ALL futures sectors
Do not hold more than 1 energy, 1 metals, 1 equity index position simultaneously — sector concentration limit
VX1! above 25: reduce all position sizes by 50%
VX1! above 30: mean-reversion only, no new trend entries
No trend entries on Friday into the weekend for energy or grains (gap risk)
Min R:R 1:1.5 for mean reversion, 1:2 for trend following

asset_notes.VX1!: Volatility futures — use as market context signal, not a directional trade. High VX = reduce risk across all positions.
asset_notes.DXY (ICEUS:DX1!): Use as macro overlay for metals and FX — do not trade DXY directly unless setup is very clean.
asset_notes.ZB1!/ZN1!: Bond direction signals equity index bias — rising bonds (falling yields) = tailwind for NQ/ES.
asset_notes.NG1!: Natural gas is highly seasonal and mean-reverts aggressively. Prefer mean-reversion regime for NG.
asset_notes.livestock: LE, HE, GF are seasonal and report-driven (USDA). Trend regime works; size smaller due to low liquidity.
asset_notes.softs: KC (Coffee), SB (Sugar) added 2026-07-03 — weather/supply-driven cycles, comparable liquidity to livestock. Size smaller like livestock until a track record builds.
